user.title: SNDWAY SW-525B Sound Level Meter
user.description: Plug the sound level meter into a USB port on the Home Assistant host. The defaults match the SW-525B; only change the vendor/product IDs if `lsusb` reports something different.

error.cannot_connect: Could not open the USB device. Check that it is plugged in and that Home Assistant is allowed to access it.
error.invalid_id: The vendor and product IDs must be hexadecimal, for example 0483.
